description.value:
You wrench the ground within range, causing a tremor. Each creature other than you within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 kinetic damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much damage and no prone on a success. Loose earth or stone in the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared, at a rate of 1 minute per 5-foot-diameter section.

When cast using a force slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 1
